data_window: 2026-08-16 00:00 to 2026-08-19 10:50 Asia/Shanghai. Initial created/updated date-qualified GitHub Search API queries returned zero results for the future-indexed 2026 window, so discovery used live GitHub Search API results sorted by recently updated for AI agent, MCP agent, Codex agent and browser agent queries. Raw responses are saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_19_*_sort_updated.json and README audits under /tmp/radar_2026_08_19_readmes/.
source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on main; pre-existing unrelated frontend/deploy worktree changes were preserved unstaged. Discovery used unauthenticated GitHub Search API metadata for repositories matching ai agent, mcp agent, codex agent and browser agent, then fetched selected README files through raw.githubusercontent.com. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, Android-tested, desktop-tested, credential-tested, provider-tested, security-scanned or deployed.
trend_observations: The freshest visible activity is clustered around local agent operating systems: mobile and desktop shells, multi-agent coding cockpits, portable memory/observability layers, MCP bridges, sandboxed runtimes and team-facing delegation surfaces. The strongest projects are packaging agent execution as an inspectable workbench with sessions, permissions, replay or human-in-the-loop control rather than just exposing one model call. A parallel cluster is moving agent affordances into domain-specific workflows such as Figma design, Discord coordination, job search and browser-hosted coding environments.
assumptions: Scores are editorial point-in-time rankings based on GitHub API metadata, README evidence, visible product surface, install/build cues, documentation completeness, repository freshness and AI-native workflow depth. Stars and forks are snapshots from unauthenticated GitHub Search API, not exact growth deltas. Date-qualified GitHub Search returned zero for created/updated filters in this environment, so updated_at values from sort=updated results are used as the activity signal. README claims were not independently runtime-verified. Pure skill collections, generic lists, thin wrappers, paper/training repos and concept-only READMEs were downgraded or skipped.
